title: Build, Test & Publish Validation — Deprecated Commands Removal
description: Final validation gate for the remove-deprecated-commands plan. Run a full build, unit test suite, and binary rebuild. Verify that no deprecated command entry appears in any help output, and that all removed commands return a non-zero exit code rather than a deprecation warning. This is Phase 5 of the remove-deprecated-commands-1 plan.
prerequisiteState: Stories 37–40 are all complete. No deprecated command classes, no DeprecationHelper, and no stale test comments remain in the codebase.
goal: After this story: all platform binaries under build/ are rebuilt from the clean source. 'zapi --help' at every level shows zero deprecated entries. All previously deprecated commands return a non-zero exit code when invoked. dotnet test passes with zero failures.
scope: Run 'dotnet build src/zapi-cli.sln' — must exit 0 with 0 errors and 0 warnings related to missing types or deprecated references.
Run 'dotnet test src/zapi-cli.sln --logger "console;verbosity=normal"' — all tests must pass, 0 failures, 0 skipped.
Run './publish-all.sh' from the workspace root to rebuild all platform binaries. Confirm the script exits 0.
Run './build/osx-arm64/zapi -h' and verify: no 'scope' branch in the root command list.
Run './build/osx-arm64/zapi account -h' and verify: commands shown are login, list, show, set-default, use, remove, refresh, rename, scope — no 're-auth', no '[Deprecated]'.
Run './build/osx-arm64/zapi api -h' and verify: sub-commands shown are request, req, endpoints — no 'call', no 'registry', no '[Deprecated]'.
Run './build/osx-arm64/zapi util -h' and verify: sub-commands shown are timestamp, uuid, now — no 'time-ms', no 'time-now', no '[Deprecated]'.
Run './build/osx-arm64/zapi trace -h' and verify: sub-commands shown are start, list, export, close, reopen, remove, config — no 'session', no '[Deprecated]'.

Run each removed command and confirm it exits non-zero with an 'unknown command' error (not a deprecation warning): 'zapi account re-auth --name x', 'zapi api call --help', 'zapi api registry list', 'zapi util time-ms', 'zapi util time-now', 'zapi scope add --account x --scope y', 'zapi trace session start --name x'.
Update plan/remove-deprecated-commands-1.md: mark TASK-022 and TASK-023 completed with today's date, and mark TASK-066 completed.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build src/zapi-cli.sln exits 0 with 0 errors
dotnet test exits 0 with all tests passing
All 7 removed commands return non-zero exit code when invoked (no deprecation warning, no execution)
plan/remove-deprecated-commands-1.md has TASK-022, TASK-023, TASK-066 marked completed
contextForAgent: Use './build/osx-arm64/zapi' for all help and smoke checks when running on macOS arm64. The './publish-all.sh' script builds all 5 platform targets (linux-arm64, linux-x64, osx-arm64, osx-x64, win-x64). The smoke checks in 5c (account login, scope add with real OAuth) require live accounts and are outside scope for an autonomous agent — skip those. Focus on the help-output and error-exit checks in 5b and 5d, plus the build/test/publish in 5a and 5e.
